limits: Teacher crossings are not human recognition boundaries or human probabilities.
A nine-point profile cannot prove absence of unsampled crossings.
Stopping in a numerical band yields variable bracket widths; not every bracket is finely localized.
Numeric-band guarantees use the fixed padded batch contract; variable-batch checks verify signs, not identical margins.
The prior failed run did not persist its final logits, so its exact failure cause remains unproven.
The equals sign lacks admitted real TRAIN data; mathbb N lacks adequate same-topology fit support.
required_next_evidence: Independent blind human votes on originals, controls and teacher-boundary candidates; fresh writer/device acceptance before any product promotion.
